comparison.objective: Hook two gondola brackets into marked slots and seat a shelf; candidate sets and locks a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Pitch, insert, and swing keyed brackets into slots, then perform a bimanual shelf lift and seating.
comparison.success_condition: Scores each released bracket seated at level 3 and the shelf captured across both; candidate scores angular accuracy and retained cycles.
comparison.reason: Hook-and-slot insertion plus shelf placement is mechanically different from coupled screw/jam-nut adjustment.
